correctness.rationale: Proof enumerates the exact three types of independent set (neither pole, first pole, second pole) and expresses their complex as X with two cones. Standard path classifications give four residue regimes; the only non-null attaching map, in the all-one-residue case, is a homotopy equivalence by the contractible link of a path endpoint. The all-length-two empty-base case is explicitly resolved as three components. The 70 exact mod-two boundary tests corroborate this but do not replace the uniform integral homotopy proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: A general cofibre splitting method does not imply the requisite attaching maps are null or homotopy equivalences across all mixed residues; those are proved here. The known theta case is at most a fixed-arm subcase, not a dominating parameter theorem.

value.rationale: Natural complete classification of arbitrary edge-spined multitheta networks (at least four parallel pole-to-pole routes), with arbitrary lengths and unbounded pole degree. Four sharp mod-three phases, exact sphere dimension and multiplicity, and the unexpected global bound of two sphere summands have mathematical content beyond finite examples or textbook substitution.
